# Test Fixtures

JSON fixture files for unit and widget tests. Each file is added when its corresponding user story is implemented.

| Fixture | Story | Used by |
|---------|-------|---------|
| agent.json | US-AG-001 | auth module tests |
| dashboard.json | US-AG-002 | dashboard provider tests |
| customer_lookup.json | US-AG-003 | cash-in search test |
| cash_in_result.json | US-AG-003 | cash-in result screen test |
| pickup_code_lookup.json | US-AG-004 | cash-out scan test |
| cash_out_result.json | US-AG-004 | cash-out result screen test |
| customer_profile.json | US-AG-005 | customer onboarding tests |
| registration_result.json | US-AG-005 | customer registration test |
| agent_transactions.json | US-AG-006 | transaction list test |
| float_balance.json | US-AG-007 | float screen test |
| float_history.json | US-AG-007 | float history test |
| commission_balance.json | US-AG-008 | commission screen test |
| commission_entries.json | US-AG-008 | commission history test |
| notification.json | US-AG-009 | notifications test |
